items.seed_concept: A compact closed cluster in which the shared realm is layered vertically: the commons volume forms the base and an arts loft rides on its roof, making one cultural block for gathering, performance and making. A civic block crowned by the library and a plain academic bar complete a triangle, each mass joined to both others.
defining_changes: administration moves from the civic block with library crown to the commons with arts loft
brief_preferences_given_up: art and music leave the ground floor
media is not above administration

items.seed_concept: Three free-standing pavilions on shared grounds with no built connections, read as a small campus. A self-sufficient learning pavilion also holds daily care. A community pavilion for athletics and dining can open on its own. A low civic-arts pavilion sits at arrival with the library above the office. Movement between the pavilions is outdoors.
defining_changes: gym and dining moves from the independent community pavilion to the low civic-arts pavilion
other_changes: custodial moves from the self-sufficient learning pavilion to the independent community pavilion
brief_preferences_given_up: not every mass reaches three floors

items.seed_concept: A linear chain of three masses: a learning bar at one end, a community commons at the other, and a civic hinge between them. The hinge gathers the school's public face (arrival, the office, the arts and the library) and acts as front door and crossroads, so every passage between learning and commons crosses it.
defining_changes: special education moves from the learning bar at chain end to the community commons at chain end
brief_preferences_given_up: not every mass reaches three floors

items.seed_name: Commons Heart Between Front and Learning
items.seed_concept: The commons is the central heart, with a civic front on one side and a learning wing on the other, each joined only through the heart. Arrival leads into the shared volume, and the learning wing lies beyond it, buffered from public entry. The arts move into the learning wing as part of daily teaching.
defining_changes: the civic front and the central commons heart lose their direct link
brief_preferences_given_up: not every mass reaches three floors
